customManagers.description: Images started by a workflow `run:`: the github-actions manager only reads `uses:`, `container:` and `services:`. A `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment above a `SOME_IMAGE: name:tag` env var catches them
The Dev Services PostgreSQL image in application.properties: no manager parses .properties, so the test database silently stayed a major behind the one every deployment runs

The Node.js Quinoa downloads to build the frontend, pinned to a patch in application.properties: no manager reads it, and ToolchainPinsStructuralTest only compares the major with mise.toml, so the patch drifted from the one the CI runner installs

packageRules.description: Wait a week before proposing a newly published version: a compromised release is usually pulled within days. Said once, for every package: a rule below that does not repeat it is not exempt from it

Maven depName is groupId:artifactId, and the default topic « dependency {{depName}} » pushed the subject past the 71 characters check-commits.sh allows (« io.quarkiverse.mcp:quarkus-mcp-server-http » made 77, « ai.timefold.solver:timefold-solver-core » 78): the artifactId alone names the dependency, and the noun is dropped for the same reason
Quarkus platform and extensions move together
Test-only dependencies: one grouped PR for minor and patch
Maven build plugins: one grouped PR for minor and patch
Angular frontend (src/main/webui): Angular packages move together
Other frontend dependencies: one grouped PR for minor and patch
The CI container image must follow @playwright/test: a drift hands the suite a browser the image does not tool
GitHub Actions: one grouped PR for minor and patch
Container base images used by the app and the tests
Maven is pinned twice — mise.toml and the wrapper: one PR, or the two drift apart
Java major upgrades touch Dockerfiles, mise.toml, the pom and the workflows: handle them manually
PostgreSQL major upgrades imply a data migration

jsonschema-generator major upgrades can break quarkus-mcp-server-http, which bundles its own victools-based generator built against an older major (mismatched majors crash MCP startup with NoSuchMethodError): handle them manually
